title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 18 — Invitation Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: You are the secretary of a local community running club. You would like to invite a well-known local athlete, Ms Rivera, to speak at your club's upcoming monthly meeting about her experience of training for and completing a full marathon for the first time.
questions.prompt:
You are the secretary of a local community running club. You would like to invite a well-known local athlete, Ms Rivera, to speak at your club's upcoming monthly meeting about her experience of training for and completing a full marathon for the first time.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• introduce yourself and the running club
• explain why you would like her to speak and what topics you hope she can cover
• provide details of the date, time, and venue and politely ask her to confirm her availability

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: Participation in sport and regular physical activity among young people has declined significantly in many countries in recent years. What do you think are the main causes of this decline and what could be done to reverse the trend?
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
